interpretation_limits: Candidate and quadratic keep identical full-quadratic architecture and training data; the candidate centers the existing initialization ridge on the already computed affine precursor. The public arm retains its simpler architecture.
Initial-to-selected changes describe optimization under the unchanged normalized loss and original checkpoint selection. Group diagnostics do not select a new checkpoint.
Differences in training changes are an arithmetic decomposition. They do not establish a universal causal explanation beyond this frozen initializer-only intervention on these recordings.

Coefficient norms and affine-reference displacement describe normalized parameters, not physical importance. The quadratic applied prior is zero; its affine-reference displacement is a separate diagnostic. No coefficient measure changes optimization or selection.
Backward residuals and captured initializer input identities are copied from sealed witness evidence; the separate independent audit reconstructs matrix products without solving normal equations.
No intermediate checkpoint is evaluated on test queries. Test outputs are only the originally selected saved predictors.
Crazyflow errors with missing truth are conditional on available valid prefixes; failed parents and prediction failures stay visible.
Matched data and update counts do not imply equal FLOPs, calibrated envelopes, derivative fidelity, controller qualification, or public promotion.
This script reduces saved predictions; it does not independently reproduce snapshot capture, optimizer steps, predictions, or simulator physics.

integration: Integrate measured diagnostic evidence and replay harness; retain the adopted public recipe.

retrospective_training_development_diagn.evidence_scope: Retrospective post-result training/development diagnosis only; excluded from all frozen acceptance criteria. Exact cached windows and saved snapshot parameters; pinned production rollout functions. No optimizer, initializer, linear solve, held-out intermediate prediction, checkpoint reselection or new model fit.
limitations: Uses original production rollout code; does not independently validate dynamics implementation.
Training/development errors expose observed tradeoffs, not a unique causal mechanism.
Channel/group loss diagnostics never alter the original objective or selected checkpoint.

verification.alteration_scope: Thirty-one independent disposable-copy challenges: prior model/data/provenance/physics/prediction/decision/checkpoint categories plus nine initializer/coefficient challenges and one cross-arm preparation dependency. Nested checkpoint, initializer and external stage hashes are repaired for coherent attacks. External-anchor/seal rejection is separate from cache/source reconstruction and fresh physics, prediction, checkpoint-development or decision replay. No fitting or ridge solving; clean full replay is separate. Fresh replay tests saved outcomes, not an independent optimizer trajectory.
verification.analysis_scope: Selected saved test forecasts across conditions/horizons and saved development checkpoints/coefficient blocks only; no intermediate test evaluation or reselection.

independent_attempt_history.correction_scope: Attempts 1 and 2 failed auxiliary checks for portable marshal identity and NumPy array-layout reduction parity. Their reports, sources, logs and supervision are retained. The auxiliary checker was corrected; sealed evidence, canonical fitting code, model selection and fitted models did not change or rerun.

verification.independent_scope: Independent NumPy 250 ms endpoint errors for four predictors, three pairwise physical comparisons/tails, primary tail gates and four angular-repair point gates; complete metric rosters and all-horizon truth/finiteness; exact prior public-excited/quadratic revisions, byte-exact historical excitation imports, hash-selected caches, six base norms, state-input/autonomous scales and exact loss weights. Every arm checkpoint manifest, including failure or unavailable preparation, is checked against its outcome and trusted public-excited cache; all captured saved checkpoint predictions are independently reduced into channel/group MSE, objective contributions and parent tails with objective atol1e-12/rtol1e-10. Actual candidate D/Y/A/B0/centered-RHS fingerprints are independently rebuilt with matrix products but no solver; shared affine precursor arrays, zero versus affine applied priors, source-bound initialization identity, saved normal-equation residuals and every generic coefficient displacement are checked. Combined logic, reported aggregate gate arithmetic and bootstrap hash equality are checked. No independent other-horizon test scores, full-horizon test aggregates, bootstrap draws, optimizer trajectories, checkpoint capture, model prediction or simulator execution; historical excitation assignment is inherited from externally anchored prior evidence.
